title: Holographic generative flows with AdS/CFT
summary: Holography, in the form of the anti-de Sitter/conformal field theory (AdS/CFT) correspondence, offers a natural setting for generative modelling. Data on a boundary manifold lifts into a higher-dimensional bulk through a propagator, and this extra dimension plays the role of a flow parameter. We exploit this structure to build GenAdS, an approach to generative flow matching in which the dynamics are represented by the evolution of fields in AdS, together with a residual correction learned by a neural network.
